title: Throwing - Bridge Ball
area_size: Adapt to player numbers and ability
description: This exercise to develop throwing skills challenges the players to roll the ball with more accuracy
coaching_points: Keep players active, reinforce decision-making and adapt space, rules and numbers to ensure meaningful involvement.
setup: The players work in pairs One player stands with their legs astride The other player rolls the ball between the legs of their partner using a one-handed underarm technique Follow the ball and attempt to pick it up at the other side Switch roles after a set time Move around the playing area after every go Key Points Ensure the players have enough room to perform the exercise safely When rolling the ball stand facing partner with one foot in front of the other Equipment An inventory of equipment to support Have a Ball exercises is available in the Resources section Rate this activity Select rating Give Throwing - Bridge Ball 1/5 Give Throwing - Bridge Ball 2/5 Give Throwing - Bridge Ball 3/5 Give Throwing - Bridge Ball 4/5 Give Throwing - Bridge Ball 5/5 Give Throwing - Bridge Ball 1/5 Give Throwing - Bridge Ball 2/5 Give Throwing - Bridge Ball 3/5 Give Throwing - Bridge Ball 4/5 Give Throwing - Bridge Ball 5/5 Rate Footer Privacy Terms & Conditions Contact us FAQ Powered by Enovation

title: Throwing - Hand to Hand Roll
